- dialog "Loop issues":

      - listitem:
        - code: e2
        - text: from
        - code: subject
        - text: output
        - code: route-3
        - text: to
        - code: other
        - button "Remove edge e2"

    - paragraph: Nodes
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - 'button "subject: 1 issue"':
          - code: subject
          - text: ": 1 issue"
